name: @thirdlight/commands
description: Thirdlight pure command validation/application and history (docs/contracts/commands.md, M1): strict request validation, the five mutation ops (createEntity, setTransform, deleteEntity, undo, redo), change/inverse data, the in-memory history model, and structured errors. Pure logic - no filesystem, transport, UI, or three.js; the workspace package (packet 07) owns request serialization, durable revision/dedup state, and persistence (dependencies.md S2/S4.1/S4.3).
